analysis.title: Synthetic study
analysis.summary: A small made-up study that shows every feature of fvTrace.

questions.title: Effect
questions.text: Does the treatment change the marker?

facts.subject: S
facts.text: The analysis compares the average marker level of treated samples with that of untreated control samples.

evidence.summary: A Lean proof that the comparison is computed as described.

facts.subject: S
facts.text: The marker level is higher in treated samples.

facts.subject: S
facts.text: The assumptions of the statistical model hold for this data.

facts.subject: S
facts.text: When samples are randomly assigned and do not affect each other, the difference between the group averages measures the average effect of the treatment, up to chance.

evidence.summary: A Lean proof of the randomization result.

facts.subject: S
facts.text: The comparison, random assignment, independent samples, the higher marker level and the statistical model together show that the treatment raises the marker.

facts.subject: N
facts.text: The marker level is higher in the treated samples of the new cohort.

facts.subject: N
facts.text: A higher marker level in the treated samples of the new cohort is enough to say that the rise appears there too.

facts.subject: S
facts.text: Samples were randomly assigned to treatment or control.

facts.subject: S
facts.text: Treating one sample does not affect another sample.

claims.question: Q1
claims.subject: S
claims.text: The difference between treated and control samples measures the average effect of the treatment.

claims.question: Q1
claims.subject: N
claims.text: The rise also appears in a new cohort.

experiments.subject: S
experiments.title: Check the result table
experiments.method: A proved checker reads the result table.
experiments.caveat: Inconclusive when the table is incomplete.

experiments.subject: S
experiments.title: Ask the owner
experiments.method: The data owner rules on sampling.

experiments.subject: N
experiments.title: Collect a new cohort
experiments.method: Sample new animals, then run the proved marker checker on their data.

experiments.subject: S
experiments.title: Check the random assignment
experiments.method: A proved checker repeats the random allocation from the recorded seed and confirms the group of every sample.
experiments.resources: Allocation log and its random seed.
experiments.caveat: Shows that the recorded procedure was followed, not that the log is complete.

exclusions.subject: S
exclusions.text: An animal cannot be sampled once and twice.
